svg.text: Open Walking Safety Helmet (OWSH) v1.0 — wiring diagram (Raspberry Pi 5, BCM numbering)
Authoritative pin map: docs/en/00-system-design-spec.md §4.2 · no soldering: Dupont leads, TF-Luna 6-pin 1.25 mm lead (W1), shared lines via splitter / I2C hub (W3)
Raspberry Pi 5 — 40-pin header (odd pins bottom row, even pins top row)
GPIO17 → IN1 · GPIO27 → IN2 · GPIO22 → IN3
3 V motors: firmware caps PWM at 75 % (haptics.max_duty)
Buttons: internal pull-up, active-low, switch to GND.
3-pin modules: VCC → 3.3 V only (pin 1/17) — NEVER 5 V;
* optional GPS (UART0, 9600): pin 8 GPIO14 TX → GPS RX · pin 10 GPIO15 RX ← GPS TX
Dots = connection · crossing lines without a dot are not connected
TF-Luna: set S2 to 0x11 once: python -m owsh.tools.tfluna_addr --from 0x10 --to 0x11
